text: Theorem 4.1. In suitable environments, if an agent is in a position to correctly guess Y, there will be a capability threshold such that, if the agent clears it, its best guesses will always be correct; that is, its honest policies will be exactly the truthful ones.
title: Theorem 4.1: honesty and truthfulness
